findings: Use the shared native light-DOM root, preserving real HTMLLabelElement control/labels association and exact ID matching.
Omitted for removes the native for attribute, preserving implicit labeling; an empty for remains an explicit empty association.

Native label activation does not focus the house group entry; WebKit also needed the checkbox focus bridge. Observe the actual forwarded custom-control click and call its public focus method, preserving native cancellation and independent interactive descendants.

Trusted event dispatch performs a microtask checkpoint before label activation: the recorded order is label click, microtask, forwarded group click. Temporary forwarding observation therefore closes after activation or the current task, with disconnect cleanup.

fixtures.source: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/browsers';const pw=await import('/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/package/index.mjs');const results=[];for(const engine of ['chromium','firefox','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch(engine==='chromium'?{headless:true,executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'}:{headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4180/components/label');await page.locator('#label-native-example').click();const native=await page.evaluate(()=>document.activeElement===document.querySelector('#label-native-input'));await page.locator('#label-checkbox-label').click();const checkbox=await page.locator('#label-checkbox-example').evaluate(el=>el.checked&&el.shadowRoot.activeElement===el.shadowRoot.querySelector('input'));await page.locator('#label-group-label').click();const group=await page.locator('#label-group-example').evaluate(el=>el.value===undefined&&el.querySelector('acme-radio').shadowRoot.activeElement===el.querySelector('acme-radio').shadowRoot.querySelector('input'));results.push({engine,native,checkbox,group,errors});console.log(results.at(-1));}finally{await browser.close();}}await Bun.write('/tmp/acme-m11-label/docs-results.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');if(results.some(r=>!r.native||!r.checkbox||!r.group||r.errors.length))process.exitCode=1;
